newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain, UAE to boost telecommunications links.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain, UAE to boost telecommunications links.

text.p: Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Tuesday pledged to increase coordination in communications and multimedia services between the two Gulf Arab states.

Bahrain Telecommunication Company (Batelco) said it signed a memorandum of understanding with the Emirates Telecommunications Corp (Etisalat) "aimed at boosting and reinforcing mutual business development".

Batelco, which has one of the most advanced networks in the region, is 39 percent owned by the Bahraini government. Cable and Wireless Plc of Britain holds 20 percent and the rest is owned by investors and financial institutions.
The UAE government owns 60 percent of Etisalat. The rest is held by UAE investors.
